ageMethod.rule: PoD true_age starts at current_year. Named-character branches add their configured offset; the final else subtracts current_year and adds age, so characters without an override use native CK3 age.
ageMethod.note: 793509 is born -2500.1.1 with no named true_age override; the script falls back to native age, 3730 at the cutoff.

cutoffStateNotes: All 37 top-level mokole trait entries are born and alive on 1230.1.1; all 37 retain their top-level culture through that date.
No culture-changing date blocks occur in POD_Mokole_Characters.txt.
No one in this 37-character set holds a PoD title at exactly 1230.1.1. The first title history transitions for this set are dated 1230.1.3 or 1230.1.5.
Only 795208, 795209, and 795210 have an employer by the cutoff: POD_wraith_01 (Charon), whose title is e_stygia. Their numeric county/province location is not encoded in the Mokolé history.
Employer changes for 795206, 795207, and 795238 are dated 1230.1.5 and are future to the requested cutoff.
